brief: The Homepage needs a horizontal row of course cards that pages left and right with previous/next buttons, showing as many cards as fit. The Saved Courses section needs the same behaviour. How should the design system provide it?

recordPatterns.reason: ADR-006: offset state lives in a hook, layout stays in the page

source: ADR-006 (excluded from context: it is the case ruling)
notes: ADR-006 chose hook + pattern. The hook is checked as a secondary recordPattern, not the label, because 'compose' is the decision class. ScrollArea is left out: it was created in the same commit as this decision (bf02b1e) and its metadata names itself a carousel alternative.
